verdict.rationale: Cooley offers web document generators (Cooley GO) and a firm-owned AI initiative, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence shows a first-party MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, and the Cooley AI pages describe internal lawyer tooling rather than an agent-facing MCP interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
